Plug the cameras into the headset\'s hub. If a USB permission prompt appears, accept it (tick \"use by default\" so it doesn\'t ask again).
Without the camera permission, Android won\'t let the app read USB cameras. The app never uses the headset\'s own cameras. Allow it to continue.
